youtube_full.title: The Shepherd Finds His Sheep | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Ezekiel 34:11–16
youtube_full.description:
The Shepherd Finds His Sheep: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Ezekiel 34:11–16.

A good shepherd takes care of his sheep. He finds them grass to eat and keeps them safe.

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Willow the Warm.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: The Shepherd Finds His Sheep
1:09 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Willow the Warm
1:46 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:54 Question time
3:12 Sweet dreams
3:30 More stories, the app and the paperback
